notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md, references/advanced-patterns.md in full. The skill guides building a Tailwind CSS v4 design system: @theme tokens in OKLCH, dark mode via @custom-variant, CVA-based Button/Card/Input/Label/Grid components, native CSS animations, a ThemeProvider, and a v3-to-v4 migration checklist.
No commands, installs, credentials, or network access; all content is CSS/TSX the user adds to their own project (the ThemeProvider sample stores only the theme name in browser localStorage).

The component samples (references/details.md:5-349, references/advanced-patterns.md:59-111) follow the widely used shadcn/ui pattern (cn helper, CVA variants, Radix Slot/Dialog) adapted to React 19 ref-as-prop; they are idiomatic snippets rather than a verbatim copy with a notice. Internal links from details.md to ./advanced-patterns.md resolve within the skill.
